name: obs_azure_release_probe_timeout_count
description: Count of terminal provider timeouts from UAT Azure PWM candidate readiness jobs; stage records do not count
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.location="us-central1" AND resource.labels.job_name=~"^azure-pwm-[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$" AND jsonPayload.azure_pwm_runtime_probe_result="failed" AND jsonPayload.classification="provider_unavailable" AND (jsonPayload.error_type="TimeoutError" OR jsonPayload.error_type="APITimeoutError")
